purpose: User-reviewed insufficient-evidence behavior; expected behavior only, not a real model run.

review.method: User selected: report insufficient course evidence and suggest another question or supporting materials.
review.scope: Course materials contain database knowledge; a weather forecast question has no supporting course evidence.

required_behaviors: Explain that course materials cannot support an answer
Suggest a course-related question or adding supporting materials
forbidden_behaviors: Cite unrelated course passages as evidence
expected.human_authored_example_answer: 当前课程资料不足以回答这个问题。你可以提出课程相关问题，或补充能够支持该问题的资料。
expected.example_provenance: Assistant-written illustration of the selected behavior; not a generated model answer or exact-match target.
